name: Mimic
summary: A shape-shifting monstrosity that disguises itself as an object, sticks to creatures, and bites with acid.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.text: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {ref:glossary/disadvantage}.

actions.name: Bite
actions.attackNote: with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic
actions.onHit: —or {dmg:2d8+str:piercing} if the target is {ref:condition/grappled} by the mimic—plus {dmg:1d8:acid}.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {ref:glossary/disadvantage}.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.text: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
